public_annotation.en: Earlier reading covered the copyright page, contents, editorial note (printed p. 1) and AI: Abstract I (pp. 3–4) in the 70-page PDF, not the whole volume. The copyright year 2023 does not establish a September publication date. The alternative 77-page edition was initially acquired only incompletely. The poetic narrator is not evidence of the author’s employment history. Batch 944 obtained the complete 77-page copy and checked its copyright, contents, editorial on printed pp. 1–2 and the first editorial page visually. Differences in titles, editorial text and pagination are confirmed; edition order and first publication remain unresolved. The qualified editorial disclaimer is not an audit establishing AI-free production. Batch 945 adds reception evidence from a 2025 Vienna master’s thesis, doc-1491, through selected introduction and conclusion passages only. Its digital neo-colonialism, Ubuntu and language arguments are the researcher’s interpretation, not a collective author position or technical experiment. Edition dates remain unresolved.

summary.en: On 11 June 2024 ZAiKS published Miłosz Bembinow’s board/AI-group position: AI-assisted works retaining human creative choices may be registered under existing rules; training permission, remuneration and transparency are advocated. A registration process involving generated material was planned for late June, not verified as implemented. On 20 September 2024 ZAiKS published Monika Lubańska’s account that revised registration rules took effect on 5 June and AI-involving registration and zaiks.online changes had been introduced. This is institutional retrospective reporting, not independently verified rollout or individual registration evidence.

summary.en: Van Duyne, Clarke and Foushee introduced H.R.9112 on 2 June and referred it to House Judiciary. It proposes a right distinct from copyright/trademark for defined, deliberately targeted AI visual-style impersonation, preserving general artistic influence, independent human authorship and qualified expressive exceptions. Mere similar-output capability of general-purpose models is insufficient for liability. It is not a presently operative right.

This is an industry negotiating framework, not a concluded collective licence or a statutory tariff.

summary.en: SB 8 / Chapter 445, approved on 12 May 2026, takes effect on 1 October and amends Criminal Law §8-301. It brings specified AI and deepfake conduct within identity-fraud rules. The relevant prohibition requires knowing, wilful conduct and fraudulent intent, addressing harmful impersonation and specified false-record practices rather than generally banning AI art or stylistic imitation.
summary.original: 2026 年 5 月 12 日批准的 SB 8／第 445 章于 10 月 1 日生效，修订《刑法》第 8-301 条，将特定 AI 和深度伪造行为纳入身份欺诈规制。相关禁止要求明知、故意和欺诈意图，并针对冒用身份造成伤害及特定虚假记录行为，不是对 AI 艺术或风格模仿的一般禁令。
